name: Weirdcore
summary: Low-quality photos of empty places, red warning text, black voids, faceless shapes and old 3D or web fragments. The mood is a strange dream memory. It grew on Tumblr, Reddit and Twitter.

philosophy.core_thesis: Make a familiar thing wrong in one small way, and let the poor image quality carry the unease.
design_principles: Use a low-resolution photo (320px to 640px wide) scaled up with no smoothing, with JPEG blocks visible.
Cast the photo with a 10% to 20% colour shift to yellow-green or magenta.
Place one black rectangle (the void) at 5% to 15% of the frame over a key area.
Set one line of red (#E01B1B) text of 14px to 24px such as a number or a short phrase.
Add one wrong detail: a face with no features, a second horizon or a door with no wall.
Add a date stamp or a plus sign of 12px in a corner.
Keep the frame off-centre by 8% to 20%.

layout.grid_mechanics: No fixed grid; one image fills the frame and text sits at 3 points at the edges, 16px from the border.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 30% of the surface is a black or flat void; the spacing scale is 4, 12 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: Off-centre image and small text blocks aligned to a corner; a slight tilt of 0.5° to 2° is allowed.
layout.container_geometry: Hard rectangles with a 0px radius; black voids; no cards and no shadows.

font_pairings.note: A bitmap-like display face with a mono text face.
A plain system look for flat, cold text.
A typewriter pair for a document-found look.

hierarchy_rules: Set warning text in red and everything else in off-white.
Use at most 3 text elements per frame.

color.palette_structure: Washed yellow-green and grey midtones, with one red and one black.
color.contrast_rules: Text on void black holds at least 10:1; red is for one short line, not for body text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat colour grade, JPEG blocks, 5% to 10% noise, a vignette of 20%.
color.light_and_shadow: Flat flash or ceiling light with no soft falloff; deep black shadows.

materiality.surface_simulation: A low-quality digital photo, a screenshot or a scan of a screen.
materiality.border_rules: No border; images end at a hard edge; voids have a 0px edge.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur by design; a 1px to 2px chroma shift at edges.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Few icons; a system cursor, an error cross and a small circle at 16px, in a thin line.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Found photos of rooms, playgrounds and shops, with faceless silhouettes, eyes cut from other photos and old 3D fragments.

motion.transition_physics: Hard cuts every 1.2s to 3s; a flicker of 2 frames at 12 fps; text appears one letter at a time at 80ms per letter.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover shows a second hidden line of text; the active state cuts to a negative of the image for 120ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a quiet unease and a memory of a place that never existed.

avoid_when: The audience expects a reassuring tone.
The page sells to children or families.
The text must be fast to scan.

modifiers.how: Replace the red text with pale pastel text and add a soft bloom of 12px.
Add channel splits, repeated frames and high-contrast colour.
Replace the photo with a CRT screen, an amber text line and a hard grid.

pack.why: Pixel icons match the low-resolution, old-computer fragments of the style.

ground.why: Weirdcore uses raw, degraded images, so the ground is a flat field with visible noise and no polish.
